blocks.text: Inherited from Old East Slavic бьрати, from Proto-Slavic *bьràti (“to take”), from Proto-Balto-Slavic *bírāˀtei, from Proto-Indo-European *bʰéreti, whence English bear and Persian بردن (bordan) (“to take, to carry”).
